noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.749 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.745

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.50 vs bruit blanc 0.05
     - Hurst max: 1.106, Pente FFT: -1.435
  2. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.50 vs bruit blanc 0.05
     - Hurst max: 1.106, Pente FFT: -1.435
  3. energy (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 11.29 vs bruit blanc 0.05
     - Hurst max: 0.932, Pente FFT: -0.774

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.810
  2. susceptibility (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.894
  3. magnetization (score: 0.745)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.722
